stumbles.quote: | `--bits` | 4 | Bits per dimension used for the search |
stumbles.why: The text doesn't say which values are valid. It also doesn't say whether the value must match how the index was built, since the bits are described as used for the search, not for the build.

point: `remex search INDEX QUERY_FILE` reads comma-separated query vectors, one per line, and prints JSON Lines of nearest-neighbour ids and scores. `-k` and `--bits` tune the result count and the speed/recall tradeoff, and rescoring depends only on whether the index was built with `--keep-float`.
